SA-55
SUSPENSION AND AXLE - REAR AXLE CARRIEH
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE REAR WHEEL
Torque: 103 N,m (1,050 kgf.cm, 76 ft.fbf)
2. wt Disc brake:
REMOVE BRAKE CALIPER ANO DISC
(a) Remove the 2 bolts, brake caliper and disc.
Torque: 47 N-m (475 kgf-cm, 34 ft-lbf)
(b) Support the brake caliper securely.
3. w/ Drum brake:
REMOVE BRAKE DRUM
4. CHECK BEARING BACKLASH ANO AXLE HUB DEVIŗ
ATION
(a) Using a dial indicator, check the backlash near the center
of the axle hub.
Maximum: 0.05 mm (0.0020 in.)
If the backlash exceeds the maximum, replace the axle hub.
(b) Using a dial indicator, check the deviation at the surface
of the axle hub outside the hub boll.
Maximum: 0.07 mm (0.0028 in.)
lf the deviation exceeds the maximum, replace the axle hub.
5. w/ ABS:
DISCONNECT ABS SPEED SENSOR CONNECTOR
6. REMOVE REAR AXLE HUB
(a) Remove the 4 bolts and axle hub assembly.
Torque: 56 N,m (571 kgf,cm, 41 ft-lbf)
(b) Support the backing plate securely.
7. DISCONNECT STABILIZER BAR LINK
Remove the nut and dlsconnect stabilizer bar fink.
Torque: 44 N-m (449 kgf,cm, 32 ft,lbf)
HINT:
If the ball joint turns together with the nut, use a hexagon ( 5 mm)
wrench to hold the stud.
